scope: Authenticated project-owned synthetic train/dev evidence from the closed V44 outcome. No inference, optimizer work, private data, sealed data, threshold change, model selection, or production approval.

v43_to_v44_dev_geometry.interpretation: The intended extent treatment did not improve legend geometry and added only one condition-label match. The net gain is concentrated in x ticks, outside the treated long-text subsets. The width-only causal hypothesis is rejected for the target legend failure mode.

responsible_subsystems.subsystem: DB region geometry and line assembly
responsible_subsystems.observed: All nine participant truths are represented by a main-word region plus a separate numeric-suffix region. Main-word boxes are 85 to 96 pixels wide while participant truth boxes are 110 to 111 pixels wide. Merging the observed pairs yields IoU 0.6522 to 0.8598, with median 0.7276.
responsible_subsystems.effect: The IoU 0.5 scorer counts the main word as a geometry match, but the recognizer cannot emit the full participant label. The suffix becomes a false positive, exact recognition is 0/9, and role classification loses the complete cue.
responsible_subsystems.causal_confidence: high for the nine synthetic dev participant labels

responsible_subsystems.observed: All 187 dev raw regions carry null semantic context. The classifier supports participant-band, legend-glyph, phase-divider, and annotation-arrow context, while the current enrichment path populates only axis-title context. All nine participant fragments receive the ambiguous-peripheral warning, and the sole matched compact legend is classified Annotation.
responsible_subsystems.effect: Context-free fallback rules convert detector fragmentation into role errors. This explains matched participant and matched legend role failures, not the ten legend geometry misses.
responsible_subsystems.causal_confidence: high for the observed matched-region role decisions; broader production impact remains untested

responsible_subsystems.observed: Legend geometry remains 1/11 from V43 to V44. Eight of ten missed legends have a nonzero overlapping proposal, seven with nearest IoU from 0.25 through 0.50.
responsible_subsystems.effect: The detector usually retains partial legend evidence but fails full-box localization. The treated long-text extent schedule did not correct this compact-layout mode.
responsible_subsystems.causal_confidence: moderate; proposal overlap is measured, but renderer, font, degradation, template, and marker family remain coupled

next_bounded_action.priority: Evaluate deterministic line assembly before training another detector head.
next_bounded_action.hypothesis: A frozen geometry-only pass that merges horizontally adjacent, vertically aligned DB regions before recognition can repair whitespace-fragmented multi-token regions without changing detector weights or thresholds.
required_evidence: Choose one generic rule from train geometry only, then apply it once to all train and dev raw boxes within panel coordinates.
Report recovered truth pairs, merges spanning different truths, complete source-space geometry totals, and unchanged full truth denominators.
Do not invent merged recognition text. Recognition and role effects remain pending a real runtime implementation and complete-OCR replay.
If implemented, add end-to-end evidence that semantic context is produced from non-truth layout inputs. Existing unit tests that inject context do not prove runtime population.
prohibited_followup: No duration extension or new width-only trained candidate on this evidence.
No threshold, IoU gate, or role-label change.
No participant identifier or dev-text whitelist.

limitations: The three dev sources form one coupled held-out family, so renderer, font, degradation, template, and marker effects cannot be isolated.
The matcher uses source-space IoU 0.5. A geometry match can still be a crop that is incomplete for recognition.
The diagnosis inspects current role-classifier source and observed runtime warnings but does not replay alternate contexts.
The proposed line-assembly rule has not yet been frozen, executed, or validated.
license_review: No dependency, model, weight, data source, or license change. Existing reviewed Apache-2.0 PaddleOCR detector parent and recognizer only.
